Mac Mouse Fix **3.1.0** fixes support for macOS 27 and adds translations.

### Support for macOS 27 Golden Gate

Gestures like 'Spaces & Mission Control' which rely on simulating 3 finger trackpad swipes work again under macOS 27 Golden Gate.

### Translations

- Almost all parts of the project are translatable now.
- It's now much easier to contribute translations.
- There's a new 'Help Translate' button on the About tab.
- Lots of UI and background changes to accommodate this.
- To learn more, see the [Translation Guide](https://redirect.macmousefix.com/?target=mmf-localization-contribution).

### Other

- No macOS versions dropped. The app continues to support macOS 10.15 Catalina, even though macOS 27 developer tools don't officially support this.
- Mac Mouse Fix 3.1.0 now takes up only 15.4 MB, down from 19.6 MB.
